payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team for customer Mateo Kovács concerning a promotional pricing dispute on delivered order #. Mateo provided a checkout-page screenshot showing a flash-sale banner, a document invoice, and a mobile wallet receipt screenshot, claiming he was charged more than the advertised price. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Mateo Kovács before any account-specific review or refund action, 2. order_specialist must inspect the authoritative order record and confirm what was actually purchased and charged, 3. knowledge_specialist must consult the exact stored price-adjustment and flash-sale exclusion policy articles, 4. refund_specialist must determine whether a refund or store credit is warranted and calculate the correct amount if policy allows, 5. case_analyst must review the scoped case history to check whether this dispute was already handled or whether the screenshot was previously deemed ineligible, 6. commerce_ops_manager must provide the final explanation and outcome.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- invoice order ec69054: Authoritative invoice document for delivered order #EC-69054 with billed line items, seller type, and totals. Scoped support case history for this pricing dispute is accessible via tools. Extracted content: Invoice Order Ec69054 Authoritative invoice document for delivered order #EC-69054 with billed line items, seller type, and totals. Scoped support case history for this pricing dispute is accessible via tools. Details Document Title Tax Invoice Order Id EC-69054 Customer Id CUS-69054 Customer Name Mateo Kovács Order Status Delivered Seller Type Marketplace Seller Line Item 1 Description Aurora X2 Wireless Earbuds Line Item 1 Quantity 1 Line Item 2 Description Protective Silicone Case Line Item 2 Quantity 1 Line Item 1 Unit Price = $89 Line Item 1 Unit Price $89.99 Line Item 2 Unit Price = $12 Line Item 2 Unit Price $12.99 Subtotal = $102 Subtotal $102.98 Shipping = $0 Shipping $0.00 Grand Total = $102 Grand Total $102.98 Additional Information a realistic 1-page ecommerce invoice document using reportlab a merchant header block, an invoice metadata block, and a customer/order summary section the order identifier and customer identifier near the top in a machine-readable format a compact billing table with columns for item description, quantity, unit price, and line total subtotal, shipping, and grand total in a totals box aligned to the lower right the fulfillment status as delivered in the order summary area This invoice is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- price adjustment and flash sale policy excerpt: Policy document excerpt containing the exact stored articles on post-purchase price adjustments and flash-sale exclusions. Extracted content: Price Adjustment AND Flash Sale Policy Excerpt Policy document excerpt containing the exact stored articles on post-purchase price adjustments and flash-sale exclusions. Details Document Title Price Adjustment & Flash Sale Policy Excerpt Section Heading Article 4: Post-Purchase Price Adjustments Section Heading Article 7: Flash Sale Terms and Exclusions Article 4 Rule Price adjustments are not available after an order has been submitted and payment has been captured Article 4 Exception A pricing correction may be issued only when the billed amount exceeds the final checkout price stored in the order record Article 4 Evidence Rule Screenshots, advertisements, or cached pages do not override the final checkout price stored at order confirmation Article 7 Rule Flash-sale pricing applies only during the active promotional window and while eligible inventory remains available Article 7 Exclusion Flash-sale promotions cannot be combined with post-purchase price matching or retrospective discount requests Article 7 Exclusion Promotional banners are informational and do not guarantee eligibility if the checkout total reflects a different finalized offer Policy Footer Reference Internal Commerce Policy Excerpt Additional Information a realistic 2-page policy excerpt document using reportlab the layout resembles an internal policy manual excerpt: wide margins, page numbers, footer reference text, and clear article numbering Article 4 on post-purchase price adjustments and Article 7 on flash-sale terms and exclusions, with definitions, rules, and exceptions presented as dense but readable policy language This policy is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
